description: Defines the DnsConfigService class for managing system DNS configuration, including reading, watching, and invalidating DNS settings and hosts files. Contains nested classes for watching DNS config changes and reading hosts files.

classes.name: DnsConfigService
classes.description: Manages reading and monitoring system DNS configuration and hosts files, providing callbacks on changes.

classes.name: DnsConfigService::Watcher
classes.description: Abstract class for platform-specific DNS configuration change watchers.

classes.name: DnsConfigService::HostsReader
classes.description: Reads the system hosts file, with platform-specific logic.

classes.name: DnsConfigService::HostsReader::WorkItem
classes.description: Represents a unit of work for reading hosts files.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::ReadConfig
methods.description: Attempts to read DNS configuration asynchronously, invoking callback on success.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::WatchConfig
methods.description: Starts watching for DNS config changes, invoking callback on change.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::RefreshConfig
methods.description: Triggers a re-read of the current DNS configuration.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::TriggerOnConfigChangedForTesting
methods.description: Simulates a config change notification for testing.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::InvalidateConfig
methods.description: Marks current config as invalid, prompting re-read.

methods.name: DnsConfigService::InvalidateHosts
methods.description: Marks hosts data as invalid, prompting re-read.
